title: Filtering the sales table by numbers · part 24

steps.title: Keep total >= 174.95
steps.prompt:
Numbers compare with small symbols:
  > bigger   < smaller   = exactly   != not equal
Keep the rows where total is at least 174.95.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sales.
Add WHERE after the table name.
The test is total >= 174.95.
Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE keeps only the rows that pass the test.

steps.title: Count rows total >= 174.95
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95;
hints: Start with SELECT count(*).
FROM sales.
Add WHERE total >= 174.95.
Write: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95;
steps.memory_trick: count(*) + WHERE = 'how many pass?'

steps.title: Filter then sort: total >= 174.95
steps.prompt:
Filter first, then ORDER BY tidies what is left.
LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sales.
Add WHERE total >= 174.95.
Add ORDER BY total LIMIT 3.
Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total >= 174.95 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
